name: Bug report
about: Report something in ProfilePack that does not work as expected
labels: bug
---

<!-- Thanks for taking the time to file a bug. Please fill out the sections below so the issue can be reproduced and fixed faster. -->

## Description

<!-- A clear and concise summary of the bug. What is wrong, and where does it happen (popup, side panel, options page, or on a website)? -->

## Steps to reproduce

<!-- Numbered steps starting from a clean state, e.g.:
1. Open ...
2. Create a persona with ...
3. Navigate to ...
4. Click ...
-->

## Expected behavior

<!-- What you expected ProfilePack to do. -->

## Actual behavior

<!-- What actually happened instead. Include wrong values, missing fields, or error messages. -->

## Chrome version

<!-- From chrome://version, e.g. 131.0.6778.85 -->

## Extension version

<!-- From the extension card on chrome://extensions, e.g. 0.1.0 -->

## OS

<!-- e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14.2, Ubuntu 24.04 -->

## Website (if applicable)

<!-- The URL of the page where the problem occurs, plus a minimal HTML snippet or a link to a reduced test case if possible. Do not paste credentials or real personal data. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- If applicable, add screenshots. Redact any sensitive information first. -->

## Console errors

<!-- Errors from the page DevTools console and/or the service worker console (chrome://extensions > ProfilePack > Inspect views: service worker). Paste the full text including stack traces. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues (open and closed) for a duplicate.
- [ ] The problem reproduces on the latest build of `main`.
